{{Top|leg}}
'''Essay-Emthree''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and close companion of [[K'cri Elban]] from their time together during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. His [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] was damaged during the war, and Essay preferred the deeper, rougher tone to his voice and never got it fixed. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he played an ancient stand up [[Synthtone/Legends|synthtone]] and sung songs from the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at Elban's establishment, [[K'cri's Cafe]].
